cloud computing.subject: Cloud Computing
cloud computing.text: Explain what Platform as a Service (PaaS) is, and differentiate it from IaaS and SaaS with real-world examples.
key_points: PaaS provides hardware and runtime environment for developers
developer manages application code and data while provider manages OS and servers
IaaS gives raw infrastructure VMs and storage
SaaS delivers end-user software over the web
examples IBM Cloud Code Engine Heroku AWS Elastic Beanstalk

cloud computing.subject: Cloud Computing
cloud computing.text: What is the difference between horizontal scalability and vertical scalability in cloud architecture?
key_points: vertical scaling scale up adding CPU RAM to single node
horizontal scaling scale out adding more instances or nodes
elasticity automatic provisioning and deprovisioning based on demand
horizontal scaling offers better fault tolerance and zero downtime

cloud computing.subject: Cloud Computing
cloud computing.text: Why are container technologies like Docker and Kubernetes preferred over traditional virtual machines in cloud-native applications?
key_points: containers share host OS kernel while VMs require separate guest OS
containers are lightweight with faster startup times in seconds
Kubernetes provides automated orchestration scaling and self-healing

cloud computing.subject: Cloud Computing
cloud computing.text: Compare Public, Private, and Hybrid Cloud architectures in terms of security, cost, and compliance.
key_points: public cloud multi-tenant low cost high scalability
private cloud dedicated single-tenant infrastructure high security
hybrid cloud combines public and private connected via secure VPN or DirectLink
data sovereignty regulatory compliance in private workloads

cloud computing.subject: Cloud Computing
cloud computing.text: What is Serverless Computing or Function as a Service (FaaS), and how does its billing model work?
key_points: event-driven execution without managing server instances
automatic scale to zero when idle
pay per millisecond of execution and invocation count
examples IBM Cloud Functions AWS Lambda
